answer: Show me a hollow with a history, a reef with a receipt, a shale with a witness, and the door opens; the farm brings none of the three. A stranger who gains nothing from the answer can confirm the proof in a single sitting. Curing a proof takes 14 days, and a farm holding 635 proofs cannot cure them side by side. The strongest wall I know is Horn painter ox horn mark turned on the polishing wheel, and it is built out of each ox horn is a season of turned horn plus a signed horn record. The farm sells volume, the epoch buys proof, and the two never meet.
